preprocessing: None by Projekt Astra: the published Wikimedia 3840x1920 JPEG is copied byte-for-byte. Upstream converted the NASA EXR to an sRGB JPEG and Wikimedia generated this thumbnail; the upstream tone-mapping recipe is not documented.
content_note: Visualization from measured stellar positions, brightness and colors; not a photographic panorama. Bright Hipparcos and Tycho stars are omitted. Faint Gaia stars, dark dust-lane structure, clusters and the Magellanic Clouds remain. This is a fixed background, not a calibrated surface-brightness measurement or naked-eye visibility prediction.
